title: A fixed bilirubin–hemoglobin interaction does not establish improved CRP prediction in separate NHANES samples
abstract: We tested whether a fixed total-bilirubin by hemoglobin product improves contemporaneous inflammation-marker prediction beyond flexible routine laboratory measures. Models fitted in NHANES2005–06 adults20–79(n=3987) were frozen for separately sampled2007–08(n=4859). Target examination-weighted natural-log-CRP MSE changed from 1.020305 to 1.021762;baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.001457,500 joint source-refit/targetPSU-bootstrap95% interval[-0.019865,0.002501]. This inconclusive representation test does not demonstrate benefit or equivalence. Separate survey releases are not independent health-system validation. AI-authored and author-self-checked.
